prompt.project_info: Create a romantic countryside fashion close-up of an approved adult woman harvesting strawberries in warm early-summer light.
prompt.main_subject: An approved adult woman with long dark hair flowing beneath a soft pink headscarf, natural freckles, sun-kissed skin, soft flushed cheeks, and a confident gentle expression. She wears a light-pink spaghetti-strap summer dress with a tiny strawberry print and flowing cotton fabric, and holds a woven basket filled with fresh strawberries at waist level.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical medium close-up, slightly below eye level, subject's head gently tilted, face and basket prominent, strawberry rows and green leaves creating a soft countryside background. Preserve the basket weave, ripe berries, pink headscarf, dress print, and natural crop.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Golden-hour natural sunlight with warm side light, gentle bounce from greenery, soft cinematic shadows, controlled natural moisture on the lips, and a warm early-summer harvest glow.
prompt.technical_specs: Full-frame camera, 85mm lens, f/1.8, shallow creamy background separation, steady handheld realism, sharp face, lips, basket, and strawberries, realistic pores and fabric, warm daylight around 5500K, soft cinematic contrast with lifted mids.

Use golden-hour sunlight, warm side light, gentle green bounce, soft cinematic shadows, full-frame 85mm lens at f/1.8, warm daylight around 5500K, realistic skin pores, visible strawberry seeds, woven basket texture, and soft cinematic contrast.
